scripts.ms:env: node --version; npm --version; supabase --version; vercel --version; ls .env 2>/dev/null && echo DOTENV_PRESENT || echo DOTENV_MISSING; grep -q '^ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=sk-ant' .env 2>/dev/null && echo ANTHROPIC_KEY_PRESENT || echo ANTHROPIC_KEY_MISSING
scripts.ms:test: npx vitest run 2>&1 | tee /tmp/ms-test.log; echo TASK_DONE_MARKER >> /tmp/ms-test.log
scripts.ms:build: npm run build 2>&1 | tee /tmp/ms-build.log; echo TASK_DONE_MARKER >> /tmp/ms-build.log
scripts.ms:push: supabase db push 2>&1 | tee /tmp/ms-push.log; echo TASK_DONE_MARKER >> /tmp/ms-push.log
scripts.ms:funcs: supabase functions deploy summarize 2>&1 | tee /tmp/ms-funcs.log; supabase functions deploy consult 2>&1 | tee -a /tmp/ms-funcs.log; echo TASK_DONE_MARKER >> /tmp/ms-funcs.log
scripts.ms:secret: supabase secrets set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=$(grep '^ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=' .env | cut -d= -f2-) > /tmp/ms-secret.log 2>&1; echo done >> /tmp/ms-secret.log; echo TASK_DONE_MARKER >> /tmp/ms-secret.log
